<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="kalgerion-demons" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Kal'gerion Demons</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Kal'gerion Demons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1155600607504257024.png?v=1" alt="kalgerion_demon" title="kalgerion_demon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be killed at two locations outside Daemonheim:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Demonic Ruins in the Wilderness at level 47.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Kal'gerion Demons resource dungeon in Daemonheim.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Kal'gerion Demons are primarily killed for the Kal'gerion battle commendation drops which are a requirement for the Trimmed Completionist Cape. They also drop Demon Slayer equipment (T60 Ranged power armour) and an Adrenaline Urn which are requirements for the Daemonheim slayer log and Ultimate Slayer title.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1" alt="dungeoneering" title="dungeoneering" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 90</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 99+</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kills per hour:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Low Effort: ~340 at 120 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using T90 weapons and an upgraded cannon</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AFK: ~325 kills at 120 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using T95 weapons</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 1858.8</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~604k (AFK) &amp; 632k (Low Effort)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Due to the way Necromancy has been designed, kills per hour will increase as your Necromancy level (and hence accuracy and damage) increases.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="desirable-drops"><ins><nowiki>Desirable drops</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kal'gerion battle commendation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Trimmed Completionist Cape</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Demon slayer equipment </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325697503907910.png?v=1" alt="demonslayercirclet" title="demonslayercirclet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325695520002068.png?v=1" alt="demonslayerbody" title="demonslayerbody" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325693519302706.png?v=1" alt="demonslayerlegs" title="demonslayerlegs" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325689836716103.png?v=1" alt="demonslayergloves" title="demonslayergloves" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004325691510231041.png?v=1" alt="demonslayerboots" title="demonslayerboots" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Daemonheim Slayer collection log</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Adrenaline Urn </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717413507074.png?v=1" alt="adrenurn" title="adrenurn" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Daemonheim Slayer collection log</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Player-owned Slayer Dungeon (3 spawns)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Right click teleport on the Slayer Codex</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kal'gerion Demons resource dungeon (13 spawns)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Option 0→9 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1" alt="dgcape" title="dgcape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will take you directly outside the resource dungeon entrance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Teleport to Daemonheim using a Ring of Kinship and run South-West to the entrance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="methods-necromancy"><ins><nowiki>Methods: Necromancy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="afk"><nowiki>AFK</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The AFK method uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049230112849133589.png?v=1" alt="holyaggroverload" title="holyaggroverload" kind="icon" /><nowiki> but this method could also use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in combination with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Some notes for this method are:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1" alt="ectoplasmator" title="ectoplasmator" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Have your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofful" title="scriptureofful" kind="icon" /><nowiki> turned </nowiki><strong><nowiki>on</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1" alt="icenihil" title="icenihil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="low-effort"><nowiki>Low Effort</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The resource dungeon is not AFK for this method as there are more spawns. It is safer than the Wilderness as there are less surrounding mobs such as Abyssal Lords and Abyssal Beasts which can overwhelm the player.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The &quot;Drag&quot; mechanic will bind the player without leaving a status icon indicating such and cannot be blocked. On rare occasions this will take you out of range of your target and cause you to stop attacking - simply re-click your target.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Rarely, this same mechanic will take you out of auto-refill range of you cannon. Simply click a Kal'gerion Demon on the opposite side of your cannon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1" alt="reaverpouch" title="reaverpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1" alt="reaverscroll" title="reaverscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> set to autofire every 10s</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1" alt="ectoplasmator" title="ectoplasmator" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Alternatively, sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562486588821555.png?v=1" alt="aggressionscrim" title="aggressionscrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
